note: Speakers are role labels. Adoption attended after two weeks absent.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Week four, last of the window. Adoption are back, we will come to you properly. Platform first, contract.

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: Versioning is answered. The contract is not published yet. I am not going to give you a date I cannot hold, so I will say it is close and leave it there.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: That is a fourth week without it.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: Four weeks. Field mapping has now not moved since the sixth of July. That is four weeks of nothing on the critical path.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: I have stopped the team writing against stubs. It is rework we would throw away.

lines.speaker: Programme architect
lines.text: I signed off versioning on Wednesday. Publication is a platform action now, and it is the only thing standing between integration and moving.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Platform, is there anything other than time in the way?

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: No. It is capacity. Rate limiting and the ingress work took the week.

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: Apologies for last week, I was double-booked. Integrity fixes are in progress, dry run two is loaded, load-step tuning has started.

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: Rollback rehearsal now has an owner. It is mine, and I have the twenty-first of August against it.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Good. That has been open three weeks and it is the first time it has had a name and a date.

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: The cutover runbook is drafting. The reconciliation report is still untouched.

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: Reporting is green. Usage instrumentation moved, everything else is progressing.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: How many open items do you have now against how many you closed this week?

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: I would have to look. It feels manageable.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: Environment provisioning is in progress. Performance baseline went to review. UAT cycle two schedule is now a ticket, still open.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: Regression pack and the non-functional plan have still not moved. Four weeks. I am not going to pretend otherwise.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Owner and date on both of those, please, before the next board.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: Mine and mine. I will have dates on both by Friday.

lines.speaker: Adoption lead
lines.text: Two weeks missed, that is on me. Where we actually are: the user guide is drafting, the go-live pack has started this week.

lines.speaker: Adoption lead
lines.text: Training needs analysis is still open. It has been open since the thirtieth of June and nothing has moved on it.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Is go-live achievable on the adoption side?

lines.speaker: Adoption lead
lines.text: Assuming the training analysis closes in the next fortnight, yes. If it does not, no.

lines.speaker: Programme architect
lines.text: Worth saying that the contract, the environment and the training analysis are all the same shape. Owned in name, unmoved in practice.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Agreed. Board this afternoon. Platform and integration both go amber, adoption goes amber, and I will explain reporting to the steering group myself.
